profile.name: Rahul Dubey
profile.title: Backend Developer
terminalLines: 5+ yrs building REST APIs @ scale | Node.js · NestJS · ExpressJS

summary: Backend Developer with 4.8 years of experience (Konstant Infosolutions) building scalable RESTful APIs and full-stack web applications using Node.js, NestJS, and ExpressJS. Hands-on expertise across the full project lifecycle — from architecture and API design to deployment on Linux servers with Nginx. Delivered 10+ production projects across ride-hailing, e-commerce, on-demand services, healthcare, and SaaS domains. Experienced with payment gateway integrations (Stripe, UPI), NoSQL/SQL databases, and TypeORM/Sequelize ORMs.

experience.location: Jaipur, Rajasthan · IT Services & Product Development
points: Design and develop scalable RESTful APIs using Node.js and ExpressJS, enabling seamless communication between frontend and backend across 10+ client projects.
Integrate diverse third-party APIs (maps, SMS, notifications, social auth) into production applications, reducing client integration time by standardizing reusable modules.
Implement secure payment processing workflows using Stripe and UPI, handling end-to-end transaction lifecycles including webhooks, refunds, and subscription billing.
Work across full-stack environments (Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB, HTML/CSS/Bootstrap/jQuery) on both Windows and Linux servers, deploying applications behind Nginx.
Manage database design and optimization across MongoDB and MySQL, applying TypeORM and Sequelize for clean data access layers.
Deliver SaaS, on-demand service, e-commerce, healthcare, and ride-sharing platforms — collaborating directly with clients to translate requirements into production-ready features.
Contributed to admin panel development — built CRUD functionality for user registration module using PHP.
Implemented data export feature (Excel) for admin reporting, reducing manual data extraction effort for the operations team.
Maintained continuous learning mindset to keep pace with evolving frontend and backend technologies.
